forecast.generalSituationZh: 受一股清勁的偏東氣流影響，今明兩日廣東沿岸地區雲量較多，有一兩陣雨，早晚較為潮濕。預料一道冷鋒會在星期三橫過華南沿岸，該區北風增強及有幾陣雨，氣溫顯著下降。受隨後的東北季候風及一道雲雨帶影響，本週後期廣東沿岸早晚普遍清涼。
forecast.generalSituationEn: Under the influence of a fresh easterly airstream, it will be cloudier with one or two rain patches over the coastal areas of Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be relatively humid in the morning and at night. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China on Wednesday. Winds will strengthen from the north and there will be a few rain patches over the region. Temperatures will fall appreciably. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon and a band of rain and clouds, it will be generally cool in the morning and at night over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。早晚有一兩陣微雨，日間部分時間有陽光。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Sunny periods during the day.
days.windZh: 微風2級，漸轉東風3至4級，稍後離岸間中5級。
days.windEn: Light winds force 2, becoming east force 3 to 4, occasionally force 5 offshore later.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。早上有一兩陣雨，日間短暫時間有陽光。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches in the morning. Sunny intervals during the day.
days.windZh: 東至東南風3至4級，初時離岸間中5級。
days.windEn: East to southeast force 3 to 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，有幾陣雨。初時局部地區能見度較低。稍後氣溫顯著下降。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy with a few rain patches. Visibility relatively low in some areas at first. Temperatures will fall appreciably later.
days.windZh: 東風3級，漸轉北風4至5級，高地間中6級。
days.windEn: East force 3, becoming north force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。早晚有一兩陣雨，天氣較涼。日間部分時間天色明朗。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. Cooler with one or two rain patches in the morning and at night. Bright periods during the day.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，有一兩陣雨。天氣清涼。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches. It will be cool.
days.windZh: 北至東北風4至5級，初時離岸及高地間中6級。
days.windEn: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.

days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. Cool in the morning. Bright periods during the day.

days.windZh: 東風4至5級，初時高地間中6級。
days.windEn: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground at first.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，日間短暫時間有陽光。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. Sunny intervals during the day.
